brief:
Pro-Palestinian protesters demonstrated at Selfridges department store in central London on Black Friday, the busiest shopping day of the year. Security personnel attempted to remove a Palestinian flag raised by the demonstrators during the action.

The protest occurred as the store hosted crowds of shoppers during the annual sales event. Details of the demonstration's scale, duration, and any further confrontations remain unclear.
dek: Pro-Palestinian protesters demonstrated in a Selfridges department store in London on Black Friday.
title: Security removes Palestinian flag from London Selfridges on Black Friday
